data.promptProse: Standing under the iron canopy of a rain-swept train station platform at dusk, Bazett holds a closed umbrella, watching the warm headlights of an approaching train. The wet platform reflects ambient station lanterns and evening lights.
data.animaCaption: Standing beneath the iron canopy of a rain-washed platform with luggage by her feet, she grips a closed umbrella and watches approaching train headlights. Dusk station lanterns shimmer across the wet platform around her.
